title: Programming Scheduler
description:
Programming Scheduler / Analista de Programação

Area: Programaçao e OPEC

Entity: SportyNet

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - On-site


About Nosso SportyNet:


SportyNet, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We have distribution agreements with leading local Pay TV operators and a growing digital presence. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.


Role Overview:


As a Programming Scheduler at SportyNet, you will be responsible for organizing and updating the daily programming schedule in the playout system, ensuring accuracy and alignment with the company’s editorial and operational strategies. This role requires attention to detail, the ability to adapt quickly to live changes, and close coordination with technical and content teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Organize, input, and update the daily programming schedule in the playout system (Media+ or similar), ensuring all broadcast information is accurate and complete;


  • Make real-time operational adjustments to the schedule due to content changes, live events, or editorial strategy updates;


  • Monitor the schedule in real time, identifying inconsistencies or technical conflicts and proposing solutions in collaboration with the coordination team;


  • Collect and organize audience data from both linear and digital platforms to support content performance analysis;


  • Assist in verifying and validating the schedule with MCR and technical teams to ensure operational alignment;


  • Manage the content inventory, ensuring proper organization and availability of materials for airing.


Requirements:


  • Previous experience in TV programming, channel scheduling, or media operations;


  • Familiarity with playout systems such as Media+, Imagine, or similar;


  • Strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and agility in handling real-time adjustments;


  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and operational teams;


  • Basic understanding of audience metrics and content performance indicators;


  • Proficiency in Excel and tools for content organization and control;


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PT- BR


Visão Geral da Função:


Como Analista de Programação no SportyNet, você será responsável pela organização e atualização da grade diária de programação no sistema de playout, garantindo precisão, alinhamento técnico e aderência à estratégia editorial da empresa. Essa função exige atenção a detalhes, capacidade de resposta rápida a mudanças operacionais e colaboração próxima com as áreas técnica, editorial e de operações.


Responsabilidades:


  • Organizar, inserir e atualizar o roteiro diário de programação no sistema de playout (Media+ ou similar), assegurando que todas as informações de exibição estejam corretas e completas;


  • Realizar ajustes operacionais de última hora na grade, em função de alterações de conteúdo, transmissões ao vivo ou mudanças na estratégia editorial;


  • Monitorar a grade em tempo real, identificando inconsistências, conflitos técnicos ou operacionais, propondo soluções em conjunto com a coordenação;


  • Coletar e organizar dados de audiência das plataformas digitais e lineares, contribuindo para análises de desempenho de conteúdo;


  • Auxiliar na conferência e validação da grade de programação com o MCR e demais áreas técnicas, garantindo alinhamento entre o planejamento e a execução operacional;


  • Realizar o gerenciamento do acervo de conteúdos disponíveis para exibição, garantindo controle e organização dos arquivos.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prévia em programação de TV, grade de canais ou operações de mídia


  • Conhecimento de sistemas de playout como Media+, Imagine, ou similares;


  • Raciocínio lógico, atenção a detalhes e agilidade para lidar com ajustes em tempo real;


  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e relacionamento com áreas técnicas;


  • Conhecimento básico de indicadores de audiência e comportamento de consumo;


  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de organização de conteúdo;


  • Ingles avançado / fluente

title: Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE


Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project. The role ensures stakeholders meet digital deliverables and information requirements, with a primary focus on BIM, though it may also involve broader digital techniques like scanning and drones.


Your Role:

  • Communicate and manage internal/external information requirements
  • Help develop and maintain BIM execution plans, responsibility matrices, and other key documents
  • Configure and support common data environments (CDE) and EDMS
  • Oversee 3D model coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting
  • Provide training and support on BIM tools and processes
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models
  • Assist with resource estimation, tendering, and reporting
  • Support digital initiatives and improvements with the Head of Digital Construction


What We're looking For

  • Solid understanding of ISO 19650 and previous standards (e.g., PAS 1192)
  • Proficiency in BIM tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie)
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360)
  • Skills in automation tools (Solibri, Dynamo, Python)
  • Experience with 4D/5D modeling and Power BI for data reporting
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Detail-oriented and analytical
  • Confident, resilient, and proactive
  • Passion for digital transformation in construction


What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization


Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.


What You’ll Do:

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating Tableau datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders on the finished product.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Tableau; develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications

- Conduct technical training.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

- Maintain and process SQL Server SPs and queries.


You Must Have:


- At least 3 years of experience working as a Data Engineer.

- An understanding of Tableau administration, licensing, security, and deployment, and at least 1 year of previous work experience using Tableau.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Wind turbine bearing replacement (Visa needed) - Brasil
description:
Eosol Group is a leading company specializing in renewable energy solutions, dedicated to providing high-quality maintenance and repair services for wind turbines. Our commitment to excellence and sustainability allows us to provide exceptional services to our clients, ensuring optimal performance and longevity of their wind energy systems. As we expand our operations in Peru, we are seeking a skilled Blades Repair Technician to join our dynamic team.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced wind turbine bearing replacement to be part of our team in USA. You will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of wind turbine. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in blade repair, be detail-oriented, and possess a strong problem-solving ability. A valid visa is necessary for this role as it involves working on-site in USA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inspection: Visual inspection of bearings for signs of wear, corrosion, cracks or any other damage.
  • Testing: Perform vibration tests, oil analysis and other techniques to assess the condition of the bearings.
  • Disassembly and assembly: Careful disassembly of damaged or worn bearings and assembly of new bearings, following the manufacturer's specifications and using specialized tools.
  • Alignment and balancing: Ensure that bearings are correctly aligned and balanced to avoid vibration and premature failure.
  • Lubrication: Application of the correct amount of lubricant to ensure smooth operation and prevent wear.
  • Predictive maintenance: Implementation of predictive maintenance programs to monitor bearing condition and anticipate potential failures.
  • Repair: Repair of bearing-related components such as shafts, bearing housings and seals, if necessary.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year experience.
  • Current GWO courses.
  • Knowledge in wind turbine bearing replacement.
  • Change of residence.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing field with a focus on sustainability.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • The chance to be part of a company that values innovation and excellence in renewable energy solutions.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Project Engineer, you’ll oversee all engineering deliverables for your assigned scope, from design validation and approvals to procurement, compliance, and on-site execution. You’ll work alongside Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, and Foremen, coordinating closely with planning, commercial, and MEP teams to ensure successful delivery on time, on budget, and fully compliant.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

About Your Team

This role reports directly to the Operations Director and is part of the ALEC Data Centre Solutions core delivery team. The project delivery function oversees execution, programme coordination, stakeholder engagement, and quality control across all phases of construction. The team works closely with Planning, Commercial, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Site Operations to ensure flawless execution.

Your Role

  • Review and interpret civil engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Coordinate with consultants, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate execution.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Suprimentos
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do cargo :

Suprir a organização com um fluxo seguro de materiais e serviços para atendimento das necessidades, assegurando a continuidade de suprimentos, mantendo relacionamentos efetivos com fontes existentes e desenvolvendo fontes de suprimento alternativas. - Estudar o comportamento dos custos que compõem sua carteira de compra (Cost Breakdown)

- Analisar os gastos vinculados a sua carteira de compras (Spend Analysis)

- Avaliar riscos financeiros dos principais fornecedores (Supplier Risk Management)

- Diagnosticar e trabalhar rotineiramente em oportunidades de redução de custo tanto sob os aspectos comerciais como operacionais.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

- Curso superior completo em administração, Economia e áreas afins

- Conhecimento em Pacote Office, Matemática Financeira, Noções de Impostos, etc

Requisitos Desejáveis:

- Pós-graduação/Especialização na área de atuação

- Ter atuado no segmento de óleo e gás, gasoduto, etc.

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

You’ll report directly to the Construction Manager, with indirect reporting to the Project Manager, and will lead a team of Site Engineers and Foremen. The section management team ensures quality, safety, productivity, and coordination across MEP disciplines, collaborating closely with planning, QA/QC, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution across project zones and disciplines.

  • Issue daily/weekly installation plans and report progress.
  • Enforce method statements, risk assessments, and DSTI schedules.
  • Track material deliveries in coordination with Project Engineers.
  • Manage change and drawing/spec distribution.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. title: Gerente Contábil Sênior
description:

title: Manager, Domain Consulting - Network Security
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description

Your Career

As Domain Consultant Manager, you are the technical leader for your Domain Consultant team. Your team provides technical expertise and guidance in customers’ network security and zero trust journey. You will work closely with the Solutions Consultant Managers and their District Sales Manager counterparts to build relationships with your customers and help them detect and prevent advanced cyberattacks and breaches. You and your team will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and will evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security services that establish Palo Alto Networks as a customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

We seek a leader to develop our Domain Consultant teams, providing training and technical support as a solution expert. Additionally, you will provide feedback to the product management team on new feature requests and product improvements based on what you learn from your customer base. Your team, in partnership with the systems engineering team, will displace competitor technologies, build market share within your targeted list of major accounts, and, most importantly, help your client sleep at night as they use our products to build secure digital transactions.

Your Impact

  • Recruit and hire new Domain Consultants into the team, hiring the best talent in the industry

  • Work with your peers to develop a Domain Consultant training curriculum

  • Mentor, train, and review employees on your team, keeping them engaged and successful in their careers

  • Develop relationships with the Solutions Consultant Managers and their teams to ensure full technology coverage in key opportunities

  • Provide effective technical leadership in customer interactions, including sharing security trends and standard methodologies employed by other customers to actively be part of the selling process

  • Provide Domain Consultant expertise and fill in for existing team members if there is a resource conflict or vacation coverage challenge

  • Innovate and iterate to drive high technical validation and PoC win rates for Network Security solutions, while reducing technical validation and PoC timelines

  • Present to customers as our expert in your area at all levels in the customer hierarchy from technician to CIO

  • Lead conversations focused on industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape

  • Discuss competitor offerings in the marketplace and positions ours as the best solution

  • Support your team in documenting HLD (High-Level Design) and key use cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions

  • Review and guide your team’s technical validation plans including POV (proof of value) test plans and customer readiness/requirements

  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers to solidify reference accounts and to assist the account teams with defining plans to drive more business

  • Act as an escalation point for pre-sales and collaborate with post-sales teams for issues that arise

  • Work with product teams to build requirements and roadmap development plans for our network security customers

  • Maintain a general understanding of competitor selling strategies

  • 50% travel within the region

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience managing customer-facing sales engineering or solutions architect teams

  • 5+ years experience in sales engineering within Zero Trust, Networking, Network Security, SaaS Security or SSE/SASE

  • Solid understanding of NGFW, Network Security, SASE, CASB, Proxy, DLP and BYOD solutions

  • Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of our roadmap and technology development efforts

  • Experience delivering comprehensive security solutions

  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills

  • Experience in leading large teams, allocating resources, managing engagements and resource efficiency

  • Proficient in English

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Estágio em Engenharia (Gestão de Energia)

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Principais atividades:

  • Apoiar a gestão administrativa dos projetos da área;
  • Elaborar relatórios para acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Realizar a gestão de pedidos de faturas de energia;
  • Monitorar sistemas e apoiar nas rotinas operacionais;
  • Interagir com diferentes unidades e interfaces, mantendo boa comunicação e organização.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 6º período dos cursos de Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou Engenharia de Telecomunicações;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa comunicação;
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (3 dias presenciais por semana);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted security company – and to empower end users to connect securely and from anywhere, to all the applications they need to collaborate and get their work done, without interruptions and with an optimal network experience. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.

  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Foreman
description:
Foreman – UAE

Are you a hands-on site leader with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and daily execution excellence?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
  • Coordinate labour, materials, and equipment to optimise workflow and minimise downtime.
  • Enforce ALEC safety protocols and foster a culture of compliance and awareness.
  • Read and interpret drawings to ensure correct execution and alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor progress and take corrective action to overcome site-level challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of progress and workforce deployment.
  • Support and motivate your team, resolve on-site issues, and escalate where required.
  • Contribute to improvements in efficiency, cost control, and construction methods.
  • This is a full-time role following a Monday to Saturday work week typical of site-based positions in our industry.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 5+ years in a Foreman or similar site-based supervisory role within the GCC.
  • Technical Knowledge : Practical understanding of construction activities, materials, and sequencing.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to guide and manage small site teams effectively.
  • Communication : Clear verbal and written communication with team members and engineers.
  • Skills : Skilled in site planning, resource coordination, and drawing interpretation.
  • Safety-First Mindset : Strong awareness of HSE principles and site compliance.
  • Tools : Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); First Aider certification preferred.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

title: Senior System Engineer - Computing Technology
description:
Senior Systems Engineer, Core 42, Abu Dhabi - UAE

Please note this position requires relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE.

About Us

Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning itself at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.

The opportunity

The Senior Systems Engineer – Computing Technology engages in the design, leads implementation, and provides Level 3 expert support for large-scale private cloud computing infrastructure, with a specific emphasis on computing technologies including hardware layer, operating system, hypervisor, and orchestration services.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Co-design, implement, and manage hybrid virtualization and containerized platforms based on OpenStack, VMware VCF and/or Red Hat OpenShift ensuring platform stability, performance and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams on technology stack component evaluation and selection ensuring solutions are designed following best practices and optimized from both functional and non-functional perspectives.
  • Conduct regular capacity planning exercises to anticipate and accommodate the growing demands on the virtualized environment, ensuring it meets current and future requirements.
  • Develop and implement plans to enhance the reliability of the computing infrastructure, addressing potential points of failure and ensuring high availability of services.
  • Explore, analyze, and implement performance optimization strategies for the cloud computing environment, ensuring optimal resource utilization and responsiveness.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to conduct regular performance assessments and implement improvements based on findings.
  • Prepare and participate in complex changes to production environments supporting operational teams.
  • Develop auto-test and automation solutions for cloud platform using tools like Jenkins and Selenium along with other configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Provide L3 expert support including on-call shifts with focus on immediate incident management and resolutions, such as outages, breaches, and system failures.
  • Write and maintain relevant documentation ensuring completeness and quality.
  • Prepare and provide trainings for operational teams in the related technical domains.
  • Collaborate with security management teams to ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats.
  • Work closely with process management and operational teams and contribute to process development standardizing collaboration framework and improving collaboration efficiency

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or other relevant technology field.
  • 7+ years of experience and deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing private cloud stacks with the focus on compute and virtualization technologies.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms/stacks: OpenStack, Apache CloudStack, VMware VCF and Red Hat OpenShift and related computing technologies such as x86 hardware, OS, KVM/ESXi and orchestration services.
  • Expert level in Linux and 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux-based environments.
  • Profound understanding of hardware architecture and components (x86 and ARM, NUMA, types of memory and channels, types of NICs, etc.
  • Good understanding of network and storage types and architecture.
  • Good understanding of Cloud Native concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in managing large-scale public or private cloud environments and/or work in a cloud service provider environment is highly desirable.
  • Advanced level in programming and scripting using Python and/or Golang, bash.
  • Good knowledge in Data center network designs and related technologies (OSI model, TCP/IP stack, routing, VLAN/VxLAN, etc)
  • Understanding of storage types, architecture, and protocols such as object/block/file storages, NFS/SMB, iSCSI, FC, etc.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools like Zabbix or Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Understanding of CI/CD principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaaC) approach and software defined infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience with database management and optimization for both SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra is highly desirable.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira, Redmine, ServiceNow etc.
  • Relevant certifications in Linux, virtualization and cloud computing are a plus.
  • Knowledge and experience working with GPU-hardware and AI hardware accelerators is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

What working at Core42 offers

With a diverse team of 1,100+ employees from 68 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment. At Core42, we foster a culture grounded in trust, accountability and high performance. We are united by our values: Grit , where we overcome challenges with resilience and determination, Passion , which drives us to pursue excellence in everything we do, and Impact , as we aim to inspire progress and create meaningful change. Our team members thrive in an environment where each person’s contributions propel us forward, and together, we commit to achieving extraordinary results.

  • Competitive Salary: We offer an attractive salary package based on your skills and experience
  • Yearly Bonus: In recognition of your contributions, you will receive a performance-based annual bonus
  • Exclusive Discount Cards: Access special benefits with Esaad and Fazaa cards, offering discounts across a wide range of services
  • Premium Family Insurance: We provide comprehensive health coverage, including dental, vision and life insurance, ensuring the well-being of you and your family
  • Learning & Development: We offer access to top-tier learning platforms to help you grow in your career. Learn at your own pace with unlimited access to premium courses.

title: Draughtsman - Civil
description:
Civil Draughtsman - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil Draughtsman , you will be responsible for creating the technical drawings and plans that serve as the foundation for our construction projects. You will transform architectural and engineering concepts into accurate, detailed drawings that guide project teams through every phase of construction. Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings for building construction projects.
  • Develop general arrangement (GA) drawings, foundation plans, sections, elevations, and detail drawings.
  • Support the design team by translating conceptual sketches and technical data into accurate CAD drawings.
  • Collaborate on the development of structural layouts, floor plans, and utility networks.
  • Update and revise designs based on feedback from engineers, architects, or site observations.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, design standards, and project specifications.
  • Maintain organized and version-controlled drawing files within the design department.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, mechanical) to ensure design integration and conflict resolution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Familiarity with Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM software is advantageous.
  • Understanding of construction methods, site logistics, and temporary works.
  • Experience with local authority drawing submissions and approval processes.
  • Bachelor's in Civil Engineering / Drafting Technology or equivalent.
  • Proven experience as a draughtsman in the building construction or architectural design industry.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM tools are a strong advantage.
  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Engenheiro de Projetos de Carbono Pleno
description:
A Neoenergia se une, em mais uma nova parceria com o grupo Iberdrola, para criar a Carbon2Nature Brasil. A iniciativa reforça estratégias corporativas e diversifica a rede de projetos, gerando valor e rentabilidade sustentáveis. A joint venture conta com uma participação de 49% da Neoenergia, e 51% pela Carbon2Nature.

A Carbon2Nature Brasil tem como um dos principais objetivos desenvolver parcerias e projetos que capturam carbono por meio de soluções baseadas na natureza, gerando um impacto positivo na biodiversidade, no clima e nas comunidades locais, bem como promovendo uma economia sustentável.

Com foco no desenvolvimento de projetos de restauração e conservação da natureza, contribui com os objetivos de descarbonização por meio da comercialização de crédito de carbono de alta qualidade e financia medidas adicionais de mitigação climática para seus clientes.

Sua energia será muito importante para :

Executar e realizar monitoramento técnico de projetos voltados à geração de créditos de carbono de alta qualidade, conforme padrões e certificações nacionais e internacionais (como Verra, Gold Standard e regulamentos brasileiros). title: Bim Modeler - MEP
description:
MEP BIM Modeler - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a BIM Modeler, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming design information into precise 3D models and construction documents. You’ll support our field operations with shop drawings, schedules, and coordinated data, driving project accuracy and collaboration forward.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Review tender and IFC information (2D drawings, BIM models, asset data) per ISO19650 standards
  • Create and maintain Revit-based BIM models, including GA plans, sections, diagrams, and schedules
  • Perform clash detection and support clash avoidance coordination
  • Maintain clean, healthy BIM models following industry best practices
  • Update and revise models/documents based on RFIs, design changes, and site instructions
  • Identify inconsistencies in contract documents and flag them appropriately
  • Assist with as-built documentation and handover preparation
  • Work collaboratively in shared environments (CDE), supporting both internal and external teams
  • Follow project standards, templates, protocols, and document control procedures
  • Provide accurate technical responses to site queries and requests

What We’re Looking For

  • Technical Diploma in Architecture, Civil or Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum 3 years of BIM experience on construction projects
  • Proficient in Revit and AutoCAD
  • Familiarity with CDE platforms and coordination tools (Revizto, Navisworks)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat
  • Understanding of BIM principles and workflows
  • Strong written and spoken English skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

  • Elaborar relatórios financeiros e operacionais , fornecendo informações consistentes para a gestão, auditorias e acionistas;
  • Apoiar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal e anual , com responsabilidade pelos lançamentos contábeis relacionados às operações financeiras, como provisões, liquidações, variações cambiais e transferências de prazos;

  • Ser interlocutor junto aos auditores e à contabilidade, prestando esclarecimentos, validando informações e contribuindo para a qualidade dos reports financeiros e demonstrativos contábeis.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Formação Superior Completa em Administração, Economia ou Ciências Contábeis;

  • Capacidade analítica, atenção aos detalhes, organização e comprometimento com prazos;

Atuar de forma estratégica e analítica nas áreas de Controladoria e Planejamento Financeiro, com foco no monitoramento da performance econômico-financeira. Rio de Janeiro - RJ - Brasil

title: Educational Technology Specialist
description:
JOB MISSION:

Provide essential support to educators, and students through faculty, and the IT department in facilitating the effective use of technology for teaching and learning. This includes assisting with the integration of technology into the curriculum, troubleshooting technical issues, and promoting digital literacy among students and faculty to enhance the overall educational experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide advanced technical support to teachers and students, assisting with software and hardware issues, troubleshooting, and resolving technical challenges in the classroom and events;
  • Manage and organize digital resources, including educational software, e-books, and online materials, making them readily accessible to educators and students;
  • Facilitate training sessions and workshops for teachers and staff to enhance their digital literacy skills and proficiency with educational technology tools;
  • Assist students in using technology for academic purposes, provide guidance on research and digital projects, and foster responsible digital citizenship;
  • Ensure that classroom technology equipment, such as interactive whiteboards, projectors, and tablets, is properly set up and maintained for instructional use;
  • Collaborate with the IT department to communicate and prioritize technical needs in educational settings, ensuring the seamless functioning of technology resources;
  • Promote digital safety and responsible online behavior among students, guiding them in understanding privacy, cyberbullying prevention, and ethical technology use;
  • Collaborate with educators to integrate technology into lesson plans and curriculum, ensuring that digital tools enhance learning outcomes and align with educational goals;
  • Assist with data entry, management, and analysis related to student performance and digital learning tools, helping educators make data-informed decisions;
  • Ensure that digital resources and technology tools are accessible to all students, including those with disabilities, and provide support in implementing accessibility features;
  • Maintain an inventory of educational technology equipment, track its condition, and coordinate repairs or replacements as needed.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology is Required. This person does not need to have a teaching degree as all interactions with students will be through the teacher.

LANGUAGE:

English - Fluent

YEARS OF EXPERIENCE:

Between 3 and 5 years

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE:

  • Knowledge of K–12 curriculum design, especially IB PYP/MYP/DP frameworks
  • Experience aligning educational technology tools to enhance teaching and learning outcomes
  • Advanced knowledge of Google Workspace for Education Plus
  • Fluency with LMS platforms
  • Proficiency with instructional tools
  • Solid understanding of AI in education
  • Knowledge of coding and robotics platforms used in K–12
  • Experience designing and delivering tech PD
  • Knowledge of adult learning theory and effective faculty onboarding
  • Experience participating in EdTech rollouts, migrations, or pilots

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project.   • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360)
  • Skills in automation tools (Solibri, Dynamo, Python)
  • Experience with 4D/5D modeling and Power BI for data reporting
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Detail-oriented and analytical
  • Confident, resilient, and proactive
  • Passion for digital transformation in construction

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments

  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

title: Digital Construction Manager
description:
Digital Construction Manager - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

The Digital Construction Manager leads and oversees BIM-based information management on a project, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and external stakeholders (client, consultants, subcontractors). While their focus is on BIM, the role may extend to other digital construction tools like scanning, drones, and robotics.

Your Role:

  • Manage client expectations for BIM and ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Develop and maintain information management resources (BIM Execution Plan, EIRs, MIDP, etc.).
  • Set up BIM workflows and manage the project's CDE (Common Data Environment).
  • Lead 3D coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting.
  • Train and support project teams on BIM processes and tools.
  • Ensure QA/QC of BIM models and deliverables.
  • Report on BIM compliance and progress at the project level.
  • Contribute to tender activities and support process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 and PAS 1192 standards.
  • Proficient in BIM tools (e.g., Revit , Tekla , Navisworks , Revizto , etc.).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie).
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., BIM 360, Aconex).
  • Skills in automation , data validation , and tools like Solibri , Dynamo , and Power BI .
  • Knowledge of 4D/5D modeling and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6).
  • Strong communicator and team player.
  • Confident, resilient, and organized.
  • Detail-oriented with strong time and pressure management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

description:

Sobre a empresa:

A Full Sales System uma empresa de estruturação de processos e times comerciais.

Transformar ideias em experiências digitais que encantam, convertem e elevam a autoridade da marca.
O Web Designer é o guardião da presença visual no ambiente online unindo estética, estratégia e performance para criar páginas que não apenas impressionam, mas vendem . ;

Função:

Criar e otimizar páginas web com foco em conversão, autoridade percebida e performance nos funis de marketing.

Manter e evoluir websites: codificação de layouts (front-end), desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e implementação de melhorias contínuas.

Garantir boas práticas de CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), conduzindo e analisando testes A/B.

Acompanhar métricas de tráfego, navegabilidade e desempenho para propor ajustes baseados em dados.

Validar dados enviados pelos usuários, assegurando funcionalidade e segurança.

Pesquisar referências de design de alta performance, alinhadas à estratégia da marca.

Requisitos Técnicos

Ferramentas de design: domínio de Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, WordPress + Elementor (experiência prática comprovada).

Front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript com foco em otimização de desempenho e responsividade.

SEO on-page: implementação de boas práticas para indexação e velocidade.

Testes A/B: criação, execução e análise para melhoria contínua de páginas.

UX/UI: análise completa do fluxo de navegação e aplicação de boas práticas de usabilidade.

Tracking & analytics: uso de ferramentas de rastreamento para mapear comportamento do usuário. Conhecimento avançado de integração com Analytics (GA4) e configuração de eventos e trackeamento.

Infraestrutura básica: noções de servidores, cPanel, hospedagem e configuração de e-mails.

Agilidade de entrega sem perder qualidade visual.

Excelente acabamento gráfico e atenção aos detalhes.

Portfólio atualizado com cases de otimização e conversão comprovadas.

O que oferemos:

Vale alimentação de R$28,99 o dia Day off no dia do seu aniversário Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com foco em inovação e entrega de resultado Cultura de aprendizado contínuo, com espaço para testar, errar, ajustar e crescer Projetos desafiadores e com visibilidade real no negócio Reconhecimento pela performance e entregas Equipe colaborativa, criativa e com brilho nos olhos

O que você precisa

Notebook e celular Acesso a internet Boa comunicação verbal e bom português Alinhamento com a cultura da empresa

Local: Inicialmente Remoto e depois Híbrido

Mentorar profissionais do AR com o objetivo de compartilhar conhecimentos e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe;
Estar atualizado com as tendências do segmento de atuação, buscando novos modelos de negócios pautados em tecnologia, através de benchmarks, palestras do segmento, cursos e outros;
Atuar de forma consultiva em abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções segmentadas conforme área de atuação, potencializando a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

Ensino Superior Completo;  Vivência com vendas de ERP e soluções de software de gestão;  Vivência com vendas mais complexas;  Vivência com vendas B2B de soluções de tecnologia;  Conhecimento em soluções TOTVS;  Conhecimento do segmento de Varejo & Distribuição; Disponibilidade para atuar híbrido.

title: Gerente Operacional CM
description:
Descrição

Você é movido por desafios, tem paixão por excelência operacional e deseja fazer parte de uma startup dinâmica e inovadora? Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Operacional Sênior para fortalecer nosso time no Rio de Janeiro, com o papel de garantir a alta performance das operações, fortalecer nossa cultura e proporcionar uma experiência inesquecível para nossos residentes. Na Uliving, criamos residenciais estudantis modernos, acolhedores e cheios de vida, conectando estudantes ao lugar perfeito para viver e estudar. Como Gerente Operacional Sênior, você será referência técnica e comportamental para o time de operações, atuando como elo entre a estratégia corporativa e a execução local. Sua missão será liderar equipes, garantir a eficiência dos processos, promover ações comunitárias e desenvolver relações sólidas com parceiros e investidores. Se você tem perfil protagonista, tino hospitaleiro, experiência em gestão predial e quer transformar a vida de centenas de jovens, seu lugar é com a gente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Gerente Operacional Sênior da Uliving, suas principais responsabilidades serão: 

Estratégia e Governança Operacional

Liderar a performance da unidade (ou grupo de unidades), garantindo alinhamento com o Business Plan e metas corporativas. Atuar de forma integrada com o time comercial na definição de estratégias de precificação, promoções e parcerias. Avaliar e propor melhorias nos processos operacionais, de experiência do cliente e de gestão predial. Monitorar KPIs estratégicos e liderar planos de ação para melhoria contínua. Conduzir auditorias internas, garantindo padronização, eficiência e redução de custos.

Excelência na Jornada do Cliente

Apoiar a equipe local em situações críticas, ouvidorias e crises operacionais. Propor campanhas e diretrizes que aprimorem a experiência do residente. Estruturar e supervisionar ações de comunidade, eventos e rituais com foco regional. Fortalecer o relacionamento com pais, universidades, atléticas e parceiros locais.

Gestão Operacional e Predial

Garantir a operação contínua, segura e eficiente da unidade. Coordenar manutenção preventiva e corretiva, zelando por equipamentos e infraestrutura. Supervisionar fornecedores e assegurar o cumprimento dos padrões da marca. Desenvolver planos de capital (capex) para conservação e modernização predial.

Liderança de Equipe

Ser diretriz da equipe local, promovendo seu desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental. Estimular uma cultura de protagonismo, engajamento e alta performance. Acompanhar o desempenho da equipe, promovendo feedbacks estruturados e rituais de desenvolvimento. Estar presente na rotina das unidades, orientando e acompanhando processos operacionais.

Cultura e Comunidade

Ser embaixador(a) da Uliving e da cultura de moradia compartilhada. Liderar iniciativas de impacto social, bem-estar, vida universitária e conexão entre os residentes. Garantir que a experiência comunitária seja vibrante, inclusiva e alinhada aos valores da marca.

Relacionamento com Investidores e Stakeholders

Manter relacionamento próximo com investidores locais e parceiros estratégicos. Atuar como elo entre a unidade e áreas corporativas como Produto, Marketing, Tecnologia e Gente & Gestão. Acompanhar o desempenho financeiro e contribuir para o atingimento do ROI.

 Conformidade e Gestão de Risco

Zelar pela segurança dos moradores e da equipe. Garantir conformidade com normas técnicas, legais e regulatórias. Promover ações de mitigação de riscos operacionais e estruturais.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica

Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão Empresarial, Engenharia, Hotelaria ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência Profissional

Sólida vivência em posições de liderança operacional (mínimo de 5 anos). Experiência comprovada na gestão de manutenção predial e infraestrutura (mínimo de 2 anos). Atuação prévia com múltiplos sites, estruturas prediais complexas ou operações de hospitalidade/coliving/hotelaria. Desejável vivência com planejamento estratégico, gestão de KPIs e análise de indicadores financeiros.

Competências Técnicas e Comportamentais

Visão sistêmica e capacidade de planejamento de longo prazo. Capacidade analítica para tomada de decisões baseadas em dados. Excelente comunicação interpessoal e habilidade para lidar com múltiplos stakeholders. Postura protagonista e atitude de dono(a). Empatia, escuta ativa e forte senso de responsabilidade ética. Adaptabilidade a contextos dinâmicos, mudanças de rota e cenários de incerteza. Proatividade, resiliência e criatividade para resolução de problemas.

Este profissional também resolve problemas técnicos, realiza a instalação e configuração de sistemas e dispositivos e auxilia na implementação, instalação e treinamentos dos softwares desenvolvidos pela contratante e de parceiros.

– Formação: Técnico em Informática, Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas.

 – Sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux.

 – Suporte a impressoras e periféricos.
